Small Wooly, Big Adventures is a Companion Story of Encore that takes place in Jinzhou, Huanglong.

Summary[]

You come across Encore who is on vacation in Jinzhou. She is overjoyed to see you.
With enthusiasm, she introduces you to her friends and reserves a seat, inviting you to listen to her latest story.
You settle in, listening intently as Encore begins the story of the Wooly Warrior.
In her tale, the Wooly Warrior embarks on a perilous journey to reunite with its family, seeking the Gateway of Wishes.
"If you believe in this story and wish to make your own dreams come true, close your eyes," whispers Fairy Cloudy.
Taking her words to heart, you close your eyes, ready to plunge into a new adventure.
As you open your eyes, you find yourself within the world of the story. Soon, you cross paths with Encore, who is searching for the legendary Gateway of Wishes. She explains that you're in the Wooly Kingdom and that a way out lies at the end of the road.
You decide to journey together.
As you open your eyes, the world around you snaps back to reality.
Encore explains that only those who truly believe in her tale are welcomed into her Wooly Kingdom.
She invites you to join her Wooly Adventure Squad to see the story's end with her.
The first step in this journey is to gather the thoughts of the audience about the tale.
While collecting opinions, you meet a girl named Ying, who shares with you a treasure map leading to the Sword of Courage. This map holds a promise between Ying and her mother, with her deepest wish being to reunite with her once more.
Determined to fulfill Ying's wish and bring the Wooly Warrior's adventure to its good conclusion, you set off to uncover three legendary relics.
Upon arriving at your destination, you're suddently ambushed by a horde of monsters!
To safeguard your friends, the courageous Wooly Warrior rises to the challenge!
After defeating the monsters, your discover a mechanism at the site.
It can only be unlocked using the treasure map.
With great effort, you finally reach the top platform of the mechanism and unlock the chest—inside lies the Sword of Courage and a mysterious letter.
The letter reveals that the next relic, the Shield of Faith, is buried deep in the sands ahead.
Upon reaching the sands where the Shield of Faith is hidden, you and your team split up to search for the relic.
After discovering the Shield of Faith along with a second letter, you learn that the Wreath of Hope is hidden within the Garden.
Ying then reveals that she knows the location of the Garden, and you agree to journey there together.
When you arrive at the Garden, you find that all the Irises have withered.
Ying realizes that these flowers were meant to be a special gift from her mother. Though she knows she will never see her mother again, she still expresses her gratitude for your help.
However, Encore senses the sorrow hidden beneath Ying's calm exterior and makes a promise with Ying that she will return to the Garden to witness the Wooly Adventure Squad's journey.
After Ying leaves, Encore reveals to you the true origin of the Wooly Adventure Squad story—it was a cherished gift from her own mother.
Encore explains that this story, passed down from her mother, has always been a source of strength for her. To Encore, stories are more than just an escape—they're a way to find the courage needed for new adventures. She hopes to share that same courage with Ying.
Determined to fulfill Ying's wish and give a perfect end to Encore's story, you and Encore decide to create a Wreath of Hope. To accomplish this, you seek the help of Verina.
With Verina's guidance, you and Encore set out to find the perfect flowers that represent your feelings, weaving them together into a beautiful wreath.
After gathering the flowers, you craft the wreath, preparing to present it to Ying the next afternoon as a fulfillment of your promise.
At the appointed time, you return to the Garden and listen as Encore tells the story of the Wooly Warrior—an adventure meant for the three of you.
As the story concludes, you present the Wreath of Hope to Ying, sharing your thoughts and feelings with her.
To complete the Wreath of Hope and keep the promise with her mother, you decide to embark on one final journey to the Wooly Kingdom, in search of Irises that bloom at last.
Arriving in the Wooly Kingdom, you and Encore embrace your roles as adventurous pioneers.
The gateway that can fulfill your deepest desires is hidden in the depths of the Wooly Kingdom.
After enduring countless trials, you finally stand before the Gateway of Wishes. Beyond the gateway, the Flower of Hope awaits.
If you're ready to see your wish come true, then open the gateway.
The small warriors finally achieve their wishes, bringing a perfect end to this adventure.
As you bid farewell to the Wooly Kingdom, you know that tomorrow holds the promise of new adventures filled with hope.
You and Encore make a pinkie promise, vowing to craft the next story together. The adventure of the Wooly Warrior will never truly end.

Steps[]

  1. Listen to Encore's story
  2. Sit down and wait for the story to begin
  3. Enter Encore's fantasy world
    1. Explore the strange world
    2. Talk to Encore
    3. Go on an adventure with Encore
    4. Open the gift box
    5. Defeat the monsters in your way
    6. Enter the gateway to return to reality
  4. Understand the audience's thoughts
  5. Head to the location marked in the treasure map
  6. Defeat the Tacet Discords (0/5)
  7. Interact with the treasure map to activate the mechanism
  8. Head to the top of the platform and open the Gift Box
  9. Open the gift box
  10. Head to the beach
  11. Search for the Shield of Faith on the beach
  12. Hand over the relics to Encore
  13. Follow Ying to the Wreath
  14. Search for Verina
  15. Search for the flowers that show your feelings (Dewvetch x2, Angelica x2)
  16. Hand over the flowers to Verina
  17. Wait until the next afternoon (13:00-17:00)
  18. Head to the garden
  19. Enter the Wooly Kingdom
    1. Embark on a whole new adventure
    2. Search for a new path
    3. The adventure continues
    4. Continue forward with your companions
    5. Search for clues to open the gate
    6. Enter the Wooly Building
    7. Find the exit that leads to hope
    8. Continue onwards with your companions
    9. Search for clues to open the gate
    10. Enter the room
    11. Defeat the monsters in your way
    12. Find the mechanism
    13. Search for a way to reach the upper levels
    14. Go back and search for clues in the room (Optional)
    15. Go back to the room
    16. Keep moving
    17. Solve the hidden mechanism (Optional)
    18. Search for clues for the hidden treasure (Optional)
    19. The adventure continues. Keep going
    20. Find a way to cross
    21. Defeat the monsters in your way
    22. The adventure continues. Keep going
    23. Search for a way to the top
    24. Reach the rooftop
    25. Enter the Gateway of Wishes
    26. Bring the story to a fitting end
    27. Defeat Lord Gulpuff
    28. Find the Flower of Hope
    29. The tale has ended. It's time to return to reality.

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing the "Understand the audience's thoughts" step awards the player Treasure Map to Sword of Courage.
  • Completing the quest awards the player Wreath of Hope and the Moments with You trophy Every Loss, Every Gain.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
While in Jinzhou, you run into Encore on vacation. She extends a special invitation to you—
The adventure is about to begin! As Encore's closest friend, will you join the Wooly Warrior on this exciting journey?
(Approach the Quest Area)
Doudou: What happens next, Encore?
Mingming: Yeah, we wanna hear the rest of the story!
Encore: Oh, settle down you two. The Wooly Warrior will come out once everyone's nicely in their seats.
Encore: Plus, Encore's still waiting for a friend. Ah, there (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) is!
Encore: Rover!
Encore: Encore finally got to see you again!
Encore: Encore was wondering if you'd come, and even had Cosmos and Cloudy go scouting for you.
Something you need me for?
Encore: Encore wants you to come play with us and listen to our stories!
Encore: Everyone was so busy the last time Encore's here in Jinzhou, we didn't even get to play together.
Encore: But Encore won't let that happen again, cuz Encore's here on vacation this time!
Didn't know they gave vacations at Black Shores.
Encore: Of course, they do. Everyone at Black Shores is really nice. Even someone as busy as Aalto gets to have them.
Vacation? Is your homework done yet?
Encore: What? Encore doesn't know anything about any homework.
Encore: Anyway, since we finally got some free time, I told Aalto I wanted to visit some friends in Jinzhou.
Encore: But he just lay in his chair, bragged about how he has so much grown-up stuff to worry about and was too busy for playtime.
Encore: Oh, poor grown-ups, they're always so busy. They don't even have time for stories.
Encore: Well, too bad for Aalto. All I could do was come here by myself with my stories and Aalto's wallet.
Encore: Right, let me introduce you to everyone, but I think most of them have heard about you already.
Encore: Gather round everyone. Encore presents to you (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! Savior of Jinzhou. Hero of heroes!
That's what they call me.
Doudou: Oh, really?! So you're the big hero Encore was talking about. She said you took out that giant TD like this, this, and that! So cool!
I'm not too sure about that last part, Encore.
Encore: Oh, stop trying to hide it already!
Doudou: Yeah! Encore told us how you took out that giant TD like this, this, and that! So cool!
Doudou: Are you here for some stories, big hero?
Stories?
Mingming: Yup! Encore's stories are really fun, last time we had one about a big bad wolf that can turn itself into mist.
Rover: (Sounds a lot like Aalto...)
Doudou: Oh, oh. There's this other story about a golden-eyed kitty and its little birdie friend with gray feathers.
Rover: (This one's about me and Yangyang...)
Encore: Uh-huh! There's plenty more of them! This time Encore's got a whole new story to tell!
Encore: It's about the adventures of the Wooly Warrior. You'll love it.
Woo-hoo, I love adventures.
Encore: That's right! Adventures are the best!
Anything else besides that?
Encore: Wait till you hear the actual story. I don't wanna spoil anything just yet!
Encore: So, wanna hear Encore's stories?
Encore: If you enjoy stories, Rover, you might even get to go inside one. Whaddya say, Woolies?
Cosmos & Cloudy: Baa!
Rover: (Go inside a story... Is Encore using some kind of metaphor? Doesn't hurt to check it out I guess.)
Sure.
Encore: Great! Come, Encore's even saved a front-row seat just for you!
Encore: All right. Settle down everyone. The story's about to start!
I've got other things to do.
Encore: Well, that's too bad. I guess you have more important things to take care of...
Encore: But, if you ever wanna hear some stories, come find Encore. Encore's saved a front-row seat just for you!
(Optional - Talk to Doudou)
Doudou: Ohh, I hope Encore starts her story soon, she only finished half of it last time, and I couldn't find the rest of it in any of the books at home...
Mingming: I wonder where she gets all her stories from. I mean, she's not from around here.
Doudou: Yeah, where is Encore from? Let's ask her once the story's finished.
(Optional - Talk to Serious Child)
Serious Child: Put your feet down. You heard Encore, she won't start until everyone's nice and quiet.
Naughty Child: I don't want to listen to some lame... All right, all right. Geez.
(Optional - Talk to Skeptical Child)
Skeptical Child: Do you really believe what she says?
Skeptical Child: You know, those stories about a huge cat living in a house made out of candy, or the kind person whose heart got turned into stone by bad guys or whatever. There's no way they exist!
Confident Child: You don't know that. I'm sure they're based on things that are real. I'd bet anything the huge cat is real!
(Sit down)
Encore: All right. Settle down everyone. The story's about to start!
Serious Child: Is it about the gray birdie? We didn't get to finish it last time.
Encore: Nope, today's story will be about the Wooly Warrior and how she makes her wishes come true.
Encore: The story begins in a land of boundless imagination known as the Wooly Kingdom...
Encore: Legend says, that deep within the kingdom's castle lies a magical gateway. Whoever passes through it can have any wish come true!
Encore: To reach this gateway, you must first go over a great many obstacles.
Encore: Yet, countless adventurers still choose to embark on this journey, for each holds wishes to fulfill.
Encore: Before setting off on their quests, Fairy Cloudy will ask them:
Cloudy (Encore): "Should you pass through this mythical gateway, you will be granted endless wealth and honor, along with a treasure trove of unforgettable memories."
Cloudy (Encore): "Now answer me this... What drives you to venture on this risky journey?"
Serious Child: If you'd ask me... I'd choose wealth, that way I can buy all the Star Flakes I can eat!
Skeptical Child: Pfft. I'd definitely choose honor, that way I'll be famous, and everyone would shout my name whenever they see me, wherever!
Cloudy (Encore): "What about you, brave adventurer? Do you seek riches or fame? Baa."
Riches.
Cloudy (Encore): Thus you shall accompany the merchants and travel across the high seas to Rinascita.
Cloudy (Encore): They say treasures fill its lands, and you'll gain a fortune beyond your wildest dreams!
Fame.
Cloudy (Encore): It appears you're already quite renowned! Baa. Just traverse countless lands along the boundless horizon, and all shall know your name!
I want them all.
Encore: Ooh, so this is the kind of choice a grown-up would make!
I want neither of them.
Encore: That's something the Wooly Warrior would say! Maybe the two of you can team up and adventure together!
Encore: See? Everyone's wishes are different, which also make their journeys unique!
Encore: And among these people, there's a small adventurer that goes by the name of "Wooly Warrior." When asked about her desires, she replies:
Cosmos (Encore): "I do not seek wealth or honor. Baa."
Encore: Fairy Cloudy, greatly puzzled by this reply, goes on to ask:
Cloudy (Encore): "If you desire neither wealth nor honor, why do you choose to venture to the Gateway of Wishes?"
Cosmos (Encore): "I have but one wish, to be reunited with my family."
Encore: Fairy Cloudy nods in approval and offers her guidance to the little warrior.
Cloudy (Encore): Very well... then believe in my tale, and close your eyes, Little Warrior and her companions.
Cloudy (Encore): When you open your eyes, a brand-new adventure shall unfold before you.
Cloudy (Encore): Once we've completed this story together, your wishes will all be granted!
Encore: So, does the Wooly Warrior's companion accept this invitation?
(Close your eyes.)
Rover: Where am I...?
Encore: Hey, hey! Over here!
Rover: (Is that Encore? I should go check it out.)
(Talk to Encore)
Encore: You must be new to this place! Are you also searching for the Gateway of Wishes?
Rover: (Gateway of Wishes? Looks like I'm inside Encore's story somehow...)
Indeed I am.
Encore: That's great! How about we team up? I have a wish I want to make, too!
I just want to find my way back.
Encore: Then we'll be going in the same direction! If we reach the end of this journey and find out about the Gateway of Wishes, we'll be back to the real world in no time!
Encore: Since it's your first time here, everything must feel strange to you, huh?
Encore: This is the Wooly Kingdom, a land filled with lots and lots of woolies. Look, even the clouds are shaped like them!
Encore: You're in luck, I know this place like the back of my hand. I can be your tour guide!
Then let's go together.
Encore: Yippee! Let's go!
I want to look around on my own.
Encore: Oh. Okay then... I mean, we're heading in the same direction anyway. You can look at your part and I'll look at mine.
Encore: Fairy Cloudy told me that as long as we walk along this path, we'll get there eventually!
Encore: Once we're there, I gotta make her tell us where all the treasure is hidden...
(Open the gift box)
Cloudy: Please don't hurt me. Baa... I'm just an ordinary box. Baa...
(Head to the designated location)
Encore: "Beware." This is where many Wooly stories begin.
Encore: When the story gets longer, so will the paths ahead. We might even come across broken bridges and stuff.
Encore: Since we'll only be telling the beginning of the story this time, we should get to the end pretty soon.
(Open the gift box)
"Cosmos": Tee-hee. You're in for some surprises! Baa.
(Head to the designated location)
Encore: Look at all these monsters. Let's beat 'em up!
(Defeat the enemies)
Cloudy: Ohhh... You're finally here. Those terrible monsters. Baa...
Encore: This is Cloudy Fairy. She gets scared pretty easily, but she's really nice and will give us directions.
Rover: (She's even got all the settings prepared and everything...)
Cloudy: So you're searching for the Gateway of Wishes? Baa. All you need to do is follow this path and collect three relics. Baa...
Three relics?
Cloudy: Yes! The first relic is the Sword of Courage. To obtain it, you'll have to face all of your challenges head-on. Be careful...
Cloudy: Next, the Shield of Faith. This is a tricky one, but so long as you believe in yourself, you'll find it eventually after searching every nook and cranny.
Cloudy: And finally, the Wreath of Hope. A crown of flowers that can reflect a person's thoughts. Never withers, forever blossoming.
Cloudy: Once you've gathered all three relics, the Gateway of Wishes will open before you.
Encore: Perfect. Now that we have clues about the relics, Wooly Warrior's adventures are officially a go.
Encore: All we need to do now is go through this door and we'll be back to the real world!
Encore: Thank you, Fairy Cloudy.
Cloudy: You're very welcome, dear! If you have any more questions, do come back anytime. Baa-Baa now!
(Leave the domain)
Encore: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), welcome back from the Wooly Kingdom!
That was the Wooly Kindom?
Encore: Yuppers! It's where all the Wooly stories begin. Cosmos and Cloudy's home!
Encore: With their help, Encore can even invite friends for a visit!
Encore: But not everyone though. The Wooly Kingdom won't welcome anyone who thinks the stories are just made up.
Encore: You're different. You're one of Encore's best friends and have listened to my stories. So Encore wanted to give you a surprise!
That was actually pretty fun.
Encore: I know, right? You and I work great as a team!
The fights were a bit too realistic for me...
Encore: Really? But you have to admit, the part where Wooly Warrior kicked monster butts was suuuper cool, right?
Encore: Encore really enjoys this story. In it, Wooly Warrior and her companions worked their way out of all kinds of trouble. Just like we did.
Encore: Mom said that as long as you believe, the stories will give you strength. So whenever I think of them, it makes my heart feel warm.
Encore: And Encore wants to share this warm feeling with you and make you happy too!
Encore: Because Encore loves to play and adventure with you! It's just that everyone was so busy last time...
Encore: But, this time Encore's here on vacation! Curious about what happens next in the story, Rover?
Encore: If you are, you should join Encore's adventure team, that way we can go and find out its ending together!
Can I be the team captain?
Encore: Umm... Sure, you can be captain and Encore will be the vice-captain!
Is this turning into a make-believe game...?
Encore: Ohh, it's not make-believe, this is a serious adventure game! I've been playing it ever since I was little, it'll be a blast! This time, you can be the team captain and I can be the vice-captain!
Encore: Now, for our first team assignment, let's go find out everyone's thoughts on the story!
Encore: The joys of the story should be shared with everyone. It's not just my story.
Encore: Once we know what the audience thinks, we'll know how to work on the story going forward!
Encore: After all, it's the applause that makes for a curtain call!
Let's go ask around.
Encore: Okay! Let's see...
Encore: Look! That girl by herself over there, Encore wonders what she thinks about the story... Come on. Let's go ask her!
(Optional - Talk to Doudou)
Doudou: Wow... Become a warrior and make dreams come true! You think they'll get all the relics in the end?
Mingming: Sure they can. Did you see how they took out those monsters? A couple of relics are nothing!
Mingming: Oh, Encore's Wooly dolls are so cute... Especially that white one, it looks so fluffy and soft...
Doudou: I really wanna give it a hug.
Encore: (Mm-hmm. My Woolies are the best!)
(Optional - Talk to Serious Child)
Serious Child: What do you think about Encore's story, (‍‍misterText for male Rover‍/‍missText for female Rover‍‍)? It's so good!
Do you enjoy her stories?
Serious Child: Yes! It felt like I was in a dream... Those treasure chests were so pretty!
Serious Child: The little Wooly even patted me on the head when I opened one!
Serious Child: Oh! And the three relics they mentioned. The sword, the shield, and the wreath. I remembered all of them!
Encore: Do you think the Wooly Warrior will find them?
Serious Child: Definitely! I was even wondering what kind of wish to make once they have all three, but I think you can only ask for one...
Serious Child: Ohhh... I've got so many wishes...
(Optional - Talk to Skeptical Child)
Skeptical Child: Tsk. Encore's stories are for babies!
Encore: Hey! I heard that!
Skeptical Child: Eek! I didn't mean to...
You don't like her stories?
Skeptical Child: W-well... It's not that...
Skeptical Child: I just think it's gonna be another one of those stories where the warriors find the relics, defeat the bad guys, and open the gates for their wishes to come true. Blah, blah, blah.
Skeptical Child: There's no way something like that exists in real life...
Skeptical Child: I'm already 8 years old. You're not fooling me!
(Talk to Shy Girl)
Encore: Hey! I saw you all by yourself over here. What's your name?
Shy Girl: I-I'm Ying.
Encore: Ying! Got it! This is (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍)'s the captain of Team Wooly!
Ying: Y-Yes. Hello. You're here to ask about my thoughts on the story, right? I actually have something to ask you...
Encore: Ask away. Encore will answer anything.
Ying: O-okay... Is it true, that after gathering all three relics you can have your wishes come true?
Encore: Yeah, it's what it says in the story.
Ying: I-I'd like you to see this.
Is that a map?
Encore: Lemme see! It's a map on a piece of wood...
Encore: That looks like a lighthouse and a giant rock over here.
Encore: But Encore can't really tell exactly where it is.
It seems to be in the Central Plains.
Encore: Whoa, you could tell just from that? You must've been to every corner of Jinzhou.
Encore: There, an area on the map is circled out with a sword-shaped sign on it... Wait!
Encore: Could this be a treasure map?! That sign must be the Sword of Courage!
Encore: Encore remembers that at some point of the story, the Wooly Warrior will get her hands on a treasure map...
Encore: This map. Where did you find it?
Ying: It's from my mom... This map is a promise we made.
Ying: Mom took me to a play one time.
Ying: I remember in that play, the adventurers wanted to have their wishes come true, so with the Wooly Fairy's help, they set off to find the legendary relics. Just like in the story you told us!
Ying: After watching it, I asked Mom all the time if these relics that could make wishes come true were real, and whether we could go look for them.
Ying: But she was always busy with work as a Ranger, so she wasn't home much.
Ying: Then one day, Mom gave me this treasure map. She said she got it from the Wooly Fairy and it's for one of the hidden relics.
Ying: She told me next time she came back from work, she would go relic hunting with me and that I wouldn't have to be afraid of anything with her around.
Ying: She wanted me to think hard about what I'd wish for most once we found all the relics.
Ying: I-I thought of a lot of wishes. I wanted to have all the Star Flakes I could eat, lots and lots of new toys...
Ying: B-but now, I only have one wish...
Ying: I wanna see my mom again. There are so many things I wanna tell her.
Encore: ...
Ying: The grown-ups all said that Mom was on a mission somewhere far, far away. But I felt like they were hiding something from me.
Ying: I knew Mom's never coming home. But... I just wanted to see her again, and then I thought of her treasure map.
Ying: I told Dad about the map, and he just hugged me and didn't say anything.
Ying: But when I heard your story, I was thinking... if it's all true. Then maybe, just maybe...
Encore: Then you should join our team!
Encore: Encore knows that grown-ups always say that kind of thing just to be nice. Most of them are okay, just a little stuffy sometimes.
Encore: Encore's heard a lot of them before, so Encore can tell what's real and what's not.
Encore: Like this treasure map. It's 100% real, that's for sure!
Ying: Y-you really think so?
Encore: Yup! Trust me!
Encore: Since your mom left you this treasure map, then there's more reason we should go look for it!
Encore: Plus, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) and I are searching for an ending to the story...
Encore: Now the clue to the ending is right in our hands. Whaddya say, Captain? Let's get this journey started!
Right-o, Vice-captain.
Let's go check it out.
Encore: Team Wooly is ready to roll out. Objective: The three relics!
Encore: Hmm. I'm not really familiar with Jinzhou... Have you ever been to that place, Ying?
Ying: Yeah, Mom would sometimes take me on a field trip there. But she warned me not to go there alone because TDs might show up.
Rover: That's why she said she wanted to go with you. Together.
Encore: All right then, it's settled. Let's go, got no time to waste!
Quest Description
As the newly appointed captain of Encore's Wooly Adventure Squad, you, along with Ying and Encore, are set for a new adventure. Mission: find the three legendary relics from the tale!
(Head the designated location)
Rover: According to the treasure map, the sword should be around here somewhere.
Encore: Why are there so many Tick Tacks? Are they having a party?
Tick Tack: Tick-tack... Tick-tick-tack-tack!
Ying: They look really angry...
Don't worry.
They're not much of a threat.
Encore: No need to be afraid, Ying! We'll keep you safe!
Encore: You probably don't know this, but Wooly Warrior once met a huge cat monster a hundred times stronger than her, and she was so scared that her legs were trembling!
Ying: R-really?
Encore: That's right, but even so, she stood her ground.
Encore: Because she had all of her friends behind her, she had to fight.
Encore: Just like the situation we're in now. Ya can't let a few small TDs beat you down.
Rover: Let's make this quick, Encore.
(Defeat the enemies)
Ying: You two were incredible...
Encore: You betcha!
Encore: Wait till you see what else we can do! Am I right, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
Easy peasy, lemon squeezy.
Encore: We'll take on anything they chuck at us!
Ugh. I'm beat...
Encore: Are you sure? Doesn't look like you are. Lemme give you a quick check-up...
Encore: Oh! Cut it out already!
Encore: Quick, let's check and see if the sword's around here. Is that some kind of puzzle over there? Do we need to put something inside of it to activate it?
Encore: It's a bit too high for Ying and me to reach.
Rover: I got it. Looks like we just need to place the treasure map on top.
(Interact with the puzzle)
